item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The decree linked programs to objectives, indicators, annual performance plans and reports, assigned political and technical responsibilities, and mandated management dialogue and reporting.","notes":["The excerpt supports these program-management, performance-reporting, responsibility, and dialogue rules, but does not support the claim that qualified existing officials were required for program leadership."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The decree required internal controls, independent and objective internal audit, risk committees, audit committees with an external competent member, prior budgetary review, treasury planning, and publication of detailed budget, debt, fiscal-risk, and budget-execution information.","notes":["The excerpt supports the listed controls, audit arrangements, treasury plans, and publication requirements, but does not mention a citizen budget."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
